class.name: IfcAdvancedBrepWithVoids
class.brief_description: The IfcAdvancedBrepWithVoids is a specialization of an advanced B-rep which contains one or more voids in its interior. The voids are represented as closed shells which are defined so that the shell normal point into the void. NOTEÿ Corresponding ISO 10303-42 entity: brep_with_voids (see note above).
